name: pf-esi
description: Employees' Provident Fund and Employees' State Insurance contribution rates, wage ceilings and wage basis, for a monthly wage slip. The PF wage ceiling rose from ₹15,000 to ₹25,000 on 17 September 2026, so a September 2026 payslip is split by days across the two ceilings.

sources.title: EPFO FAQ, question 119: contribution rate payable for a member
sources.notes: Employee contributes 12% of basic wages + dearness allowance + retaining allowance; the employer also pays 12%, of which 8.33% goes to the Pension Fund (EPS) and 3.67% to the Provident Fund (EPF).

sources.title: S.O. 5109(E), Ministry of Labour and Employment, 17 September 2026
sources.notes: Notifies ₹25,000 per month as the wage ceiling for Chapter III of the Code on Social Security, 2020, with effect from publication in the Gazette (17-09-2026), in supersession of S.O. 2702(E) dated 29-05-2026.

sources.title: EPFO FAQs: Revision of EPFO statutory wage ceiling (₹15,000 to ₹25,000)
sources.notes: Confirms the earlier ceiling was ₹15,000 and the revised ceiling ₹25,000 from 17-09-2026, and that September 2026 contributions are calculated separately for 01-16 September and 17-30 September.

sources.title: ESIC: Contribution
sources.notes: Employee's contribution 0.75% and employer's 3.25% of wages, with effect from 01-07-2019.

sources.title: ESIC Standard Note on the Employees' State Insurance Scheme (as on 01-01-2025)
sources.notes: Employees drawing wages up to ₹21,000 per month (₹25,000 for persons with disability) are covered; the 0.75% / 3.25% split replaced 1.75% / 4.75% from 01-07-2019.
